categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and modifies the test utility `src/test/util/net.cpp` and fuzz harness `src/test/fuzz/torcontrol.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Substantially expands fuzz coverage for torcontrol wire parsing and fixes a socket-deletion bug in the `DynSock::Wait()` test utility. Author reports `src/torcontrol.cpp` line coverage increased from 52% to 81%, though torcontrol parsing is peripheral compared to consensus or core p2p message handling.
